newsitem.title: BELGIUM: OLO dealers eye Bund chart, French franc.
newsitem.headline: OLO dealers eye Bund chart, French franc.

text.p: Belgian linear bond futures started higher with Bunds on Tuesday, correcting Monday's fall, but most players advised selling on rallies and the market was expected to move sideways at best.
Dealers said they were eying both the Bund futures chart and the French franc closely.

The French franc improved to 3.37 to the mark, after three days of weakening ahead of President Chirac's call for early elections. Any serious weakening of the French franc is bound to weigh on the Belgian franc and push up Belgian short-term interest rates, dealers said.
The new July 24 three-month T-bill, which is auctioned at 1200 GMT, was quoted with a yield of 3.20/22 percent, from 3.201/23 at the opening and 3.18/20 Monday.
At the auction, a relatively small 102 billion francs comes to maturity.
There is also a non-competitive OLO auction today, but as prices now are below Monday's auction price, little volume is expected there.
-- Geert De Clercq, Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6813, Fax +32 2 230 7710
